findings: All six panels show original images beside corresponding native source outlines; class coloring separates drop and crystal annotations.
XChem examples include small dispersed crystals and fields without selected crystals; remaining objects are not automatically exhaustive negatives.
VMXi includes dark drop interfaces, cropped objects and very thin edge-adjacent annotations. These selected source labels require task-specific review before any adaptation to KDP silhouette rules.
Appearance and target scale differ substantially from the current single large seeded-crystal optical pilot. No transfer score or training suitability is established.
